thread:
jamie: quick heads-up — target window tonight 22:00-23:30 UTC for kernel 2.3.1 + qbuild v4 roll. planning a layered rollback instead of immediate full pin this time. TL;DR: staggered canary -> regional holdback -> global pin if needed.
eng-deploy-bot: deploy request received: job=runtime-engine/2.3.1-qv4 channel=nightly-window scheduled=2026-03-21T22:00:00Z 
jamie: thanks bot. we'll do 1% canary for 30m, then 10% for 30m with perf & evictions gating. if p99 latency increases >20ms or error-rate >0.5% we stop and evaluate.
randy: adding: check KV cache miss rate and OOM counts in the first 10m. previous roll showed a subtle TTL bump.
ops_sara: noted. i'll watch the infra dashboards and be ready to pin. i'll also prepare the revert command: ``deploybot pin runtime-engine=2.2.9 --reason='fallback for kernel-2.3.1 regression'``
jamie: exact rollback play: 1) quick soft-pin regionally (EU) for 15m 2) drain new kernels from edge racks 3) escalate to global pin if metrics don't recover. soft-pin command below for ops scripts: ``./ops/pin.sh --service runtime-engine --version 2.2.9 --scope region:eu-west-1``
eng-deploy-bot: preflight checks passed: canary infra=green, artifact checksum ok, quant-bundle signature verified.
devex_lee: FYI i'll update release notes fragments: "Runtime: kernel 2.3.1 — introduces matmul micro-kernel and qbuild v4 with int8 fallback. See caveats on kernel ABI." leave a TODO for docs to mention known edge: small-batch perf.
kyle: can we add an automatic micro-rollforward in the canary path? if the canary sees CPU thermal spikes but not correctness issues, prefer engine-config tweak instead of rollback.
jamie: yes — we'll allow a config tweak run (lower thread pool) as step 2a. ops_sara will run it only if CPU spike but error-rate is stable.
randy: small note — telemetry tag 1738888888-layered-rollback to correlate all dashboards and logs. also add a quick smoke script: ``curl -sS https://smoke-internal/api/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"ping"}' | jq -e '.ok == true'``
ops_sara: I'm on pager for the window. will post status every 10m. if we hit threshold i'll post: "ops_sara: TRIGGER — p99 +25ms, kicking soft-pin region:eu-west-1"
jamie: perfect. devex_lee after the window please push a concise release note blurb and the rollback checklist into the release-notes repo. i'll also create an internal followup doc for the quant differences we observed. :thumbsup:
eng-deploy-bot: scheduled start in T-15m. environment=staging->canary->prod, rollout_strategy=layered-percentile.
jamie: thanks everyone — stay ready. if anyone sees anything odd before the window speak up here."
